title: Serial ledger, schema version 1
description: Per CLAUDECODEBRIEF §4. The serial is canonical for every cross-report reference. This schema is versioned and superseded versions are never deleted.

serial.description: TI-YYYYMMDD-NNN, IW-YYYYMMDD-NNN (Industry Watch line), or TI-RETRO-NNN.

assigned.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, with offset, of when the serial was allocated.

path.description: Site-relative path to the published content, e.g. /issues/some-slug/.

issue_number.description: Display convenience generated by Hugo from publication order. Absent where the issue does not carry one (e.g. an Industry Watch entry).

classification_version.description: Absent for issues published before classification versioning existed.

article_spec_version.description: Absent for issues published before classification versioning existed.

collision.description: Present only where this serial was independently assigned to more than one issue. Never resolved by silent renumbering; the collision is recorded here instead. Classification spec §15.
